# Code of Conduct

🇬🇧 English | [🇮🇹 Italiano](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.it.md)

## Our commitment

Everyone should feel welcome in the Biolaris Media community. Treat people with respect, whatever their age, body size, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, experience, nationality, appearance, religion, or sexual orientation.

## Expected behavior

- Be considerate when talking with people in project spaces.
- Listen to different viewpoints and offer feedback in a helpful way.
- Keep discussions relevant, welcoming, and professional.
- Work together to make the project better for everyone.

## Unacceptable behavior

Harassment, insults, personal attacks, discrimination, intimidation, unwanted contact, and sharing someone's private information without their consent have no place here.

## Enforcement

Maintainers may remove content or limit someone's participation if this Code of Conduct is not followed. If something concerns you, use the contact information on the [project maintainer's GitHub profile](https://github.com/bispitalieri) to send a private report. They will do their best to keep it private.

This Code of Conduct applies to the project's spaces and to public conversations where someone is speaking on behalf of the project.
